responsibility: Common include wrapper for Go frontend code that centralizes the C++ standard-library headers and GCC headers needed by gccgo sources. It selects an available unordered-map/set implementation across host environments, provides compatibility macros for those containers, pulls in GCC system, core type, internationalization, and diagnostic declarations in a safe order, and defines `go_assert`/`go_unreachable` as wrappers around GCC’s assertion facilities, making it the foundational portability and environment header for GCC-integrated Go frontend code.
